The portal can also give us something else that's really valuable: a shared knowledge base.
Every team can contribute articles, helpful tips, common answers, and self-service information based on what they know.
So instead of answering the same question over and over, a team can answer it once and make that knowledge available to everyone.
What one team knows can become something the whole company can use.
And over time, that can reduce repetitive questions and give employees another way to get the information they need without having to wait for someone to respond.
